notes.title: TobPaCharge Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]Selectable Skills![/h2]
There are 2 more skills that players can choose to enhance their action!

Double Fire ball
This skill let player do 2 fireball on the same turn!
This beats both charge and fireball. (also heart charge)
But this lose to block and big fireball.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45104719/2008f7d6e3a3ee6443346a33ea4fce620d6d33d7.png[/img]

Heart Charge
This skill give one up to player, meaning that it takes 2 hit to kill a player.
Get hit by a big fireball won't kill you if you have heart charge.
But this lose to double fireball

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45104719/9810869b3998e3b024535b8e62b6fe8bfb3b2ffb.png[/img]

Both skill can only be used ONCE per game.

[h2]Cosmetic!![/h2]
There are 36 cosmetics to collect!
Both player will get random cosmetic at the game of each game.

Have fun charging!
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45104719/7f858e0ec0b3d8178cc835c34ebc37ef2ff9e344.png[/img]
